52:15.text: Is this magic, or do you not see?

52:16.text: Taste you therein its heat and whether you are patient of it or impatient of it, it is all the same. You are only being requited for what you used to do.

52:18.text: Enjoying in that which their Lord has bestowed on them, and
their Lord saved them from the torment of the blazing Fire.

52:19.text: "Eat and drink with happiness because of what you used to do."

52:20.text: on thrones arranged in ranks. And We shall marry them to Hûr:

52:21.text: And those who believe and whose offspring follow them in Faith: to them shall We join their offspring, and We shall not decrease the reward of their deeds in anything. Every person is a pledge for that which he has earned.

52:22.text: And We shall provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.

52:23.text: There they shall pass from hand to hand a
(dirty, false, evil vain talk between them)
(because it will be lawful for them to drink)

52:24.text: And there will go round boy-servants of theirs, to serve them as if they were preserved pearls.

52:25.text: And some of them draw near to others, questioning.

52:26.text: in the midst of our families.

52:27.text: "So Allâh has been gracious to us, and has saved us from the torment of the Fire.

52:28.text: (the Most Subtle, Kind, Courteous, and Generous)

52:29.text: (mankind of Islâmic Monotheism, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
. By the Grace of Allâh, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman.

52:30.text: is a poet! We await for him some calamity by time!"

52:31.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to them)
: "Wait! I am with you among the waiters!"
